source_snapshot.procedure: Configure ADDDC on a 64GB x4 population and invoke DeviceSparingHarasser with unresolved mode, plus1 and bank targets.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal health, correctable DIMM attribution, indicators dark, applicable UEFI record and `sparing_harasser PASSED`.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; delegated injection plus generic log grep does not identify bank-plus1.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Gated hybrid requiring the exact bank-plus1 contract and restoration.

old_problem: Neither bank granularity nor the enabled plus1 branch was bound to concrete harasser inputs, so corrected-error logs could be satisfied by a different ADDDC variant.
disposition_reason: The item fixes two independent coverage axes—Bank and plus1 enabled—and the source supplies the intended success observations. Under ED-03 the signed Intel recipe, bank map and target list are runtime configuration; ED-09/16 still prohibit unapproved DIMM work or injection. Requiring pre-run evidence of the enabled plus1 branch makes the case reviewable without guessing its literal value.
decision_basis: Read XLSX Reliability row 27, its DeepSeek fields, historical record 2431 and directly checked next pending row 28.
Treat Bank-with-plus1 as distinct from Bank-without-plus1 and both Rank cases.
Require package proof connecting adddcType, plus1 and each target bank to trained topology.
Retain adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False, full transcript and every physical/management criterion.

test_case.test_name: Advanced-RAS bank ADDDC with plus1 enabled
test_case.purpose: Validate bank-level Advanced-RAS ADDDC on the approved x4 memory topology while the vendor-defined plus1 feature is demonstrably enabled.
required_package: Signed CScripts build and bank-plus1 parameter contract
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator verifies the trained bank map and plus1-enabled pre-state; the FAE then executes the approved `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(...)` once for each signed bank target, preserving `adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False`. Correlate the unabridged transcript with bank/slot, health, UEFI applicability and indicator evidence before restoring the captured baseline.
test_case.expected_result: The vendor-proven bank-plus1 path reports `sparing_harasser PASSED` for every required bank, corrected events identify the intended bank/slot, the system stays healthy, both fault indicators stay off and restoration is verified.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS needs positive proof of Bank mode and plus1 enabled, complete approved targets, PASSED transcripts, correct attribution, no-light/health evidence and clean restoration. Evidence from Rank, no-plus1, generic CE, an unintended target, UCE or instability cannot pass.
safety_gate: Power down and use approved ESD handling for DIMM work.
Do not inject until package hash, bank map, plus1 state and recovery are confirmed.
Abort at the first wrong mode/target, UCE, self-check error, lamp, hang or health degradation.
Never automatically retry or advance after an anomaly.
expected_evidence: Package hash and resolved Bank/plus1 inputs
Correlated Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI and indicator captures
test_case.recovery: Freeze evidence on any deviation; the authorized operator restores DIMMs and BIOS/ADDDC/plus1 settings, verifies memory training and health, and requires a new authorization for another run.

source_conflict.reason: The review explicitly binds Bank and plus1 to vendor evidence instead of inferring them from the title or adjacent variants.
